    'Qwen_cont->Pythia':  0.3284,
    'Qwen_cont->OLMo':    0.3112,
    'Qwen_cont->Qwen_cont': 0.3875,
}

# Paper values from Table S1 (appendix.tex lines 54-57)
paper = {
    'Qwen_rw->Qwen_rw':   0.423,
    'Qwen_rw->Pythia':    0.259,
    'Qwen_rw->OLMo':      0.265,
    'Qwen_rw->Qwen_cont': 0.347,
    'Pythia->Qwen_rw':    0.272,
    'Pythia->Pythia':     0.386,
    'Pythia->OLMo':       0.353,
    'Pythia->Qwen_cont':  0.329,
    'OLMo->Qwen_rw':      0.277,

    'Qwen_cont->Qwen_rw': 0.344,
    'Qwen_cont->Pythia':  0.328,

    'Qwen_cont->Qwen_cont': 0.388,
}

print('| Location | Paper Value | Registry exp_id | Registry Value | Match? |')
print('|----------|-------------|-----------------|----------------|--------|')

mismatches = []

    pv = paper[key]
    rv = registry[key]
    # round registry value to 3dp for comparison

    if 'MISMATCH' in match:

print()

    for key, pv, rv, rv_r in mismatches:
        print(f'  {key}: paper={pv:.3f}, registry={rv:.4f} (rounded={rv_r:.3f}), diff={abs(pv-rv_r):.4f}')
else:
